card.name: Separators between numbers in ranges
card.fires_on: The space, hyphen or multiplication sign that sits between two numbers, just before the next digits. It appears in ranges, page or verse lists, dates, and scientific notation.

modes.label: Hyphen in ranges
modes.description: A hyphen or dash joining two numbers in a range, such as verses, years or dates.

modes.label: Space between numbers
modes.description: A blank space between two numbers in a list or measurement, before the next digits.

modes.label: Times sign in counts
modes.description: A multiplication sign between a number and a power of ten in a count.
